article.title: Circana擬把購買數據接入The Trade Desk受眾及衡量
article.summary: Circana與The Trade Desk公布擴展合作，計劃讓購買數據連接受眾啟動、廣告優化及成效衡量。
highlights: Intelligence Stream及Sales Lift將接入Audience Unlimited和Open Measurement。
雙方希望讓活動結果回饋後續的受眾和優化決策，整合仍屬公布中的計劃。
article.why: 以實際購買作共同訊號，會影響品牌如何挑選受眾和評估媒體；採購前可先確認能涵蓋哪些商品及通路。
article.next_step: 向合作方索取適用市場、商品覆蓋和對照組方法，再判斷是否可用於下一次銷售提升測試。
article.detail: Circana把這次合作描述為連接原本分開的受眾、優化及衡量工序。其購買資料主要服務消費品與零售領域，Open Measurement則是The Trade Desk計劃推出的框架。團隊可先列出活動中的商品及販售通路，確認資料能否覆蓋，再核對銷售提升的計算方法和比較基準，決定測試是否可行。
article.title_en: Circana plans purchase-data links to Trade Desk audiences and measurement
article.summary_en: Circana and The Trade Desk expanded their partnership with planned links between purchase data, audience activation, optimization and measurement.
highlights_en: Intelligence Stream and Sales Lift will connect to Audience Unlimited and Open Measurement.
The planned feedback loop uses campaign outcomes to inform later audience and optimization decisions.
article.why_en: A shared purchase signal affects audience selection and media evaluation. Buyers can first establish product and channel coverage.
article.next_step_en: Request market coverage, product coverage and control-group methods before planning a sales-lift test.
article.detail_en: Circana describes the partnership as connecting previously separate audience, optimization and measurement work. Its purchase intelligence serves consumer goods and retail, while Open Measurement is a planned Trade Desk framework. Match campaign products and sales channels to coverage, then assess the sales-lift method and comparison baseline.
